question: I'm preparing the year-end audit of club spending. For each item Sacha Harrison bought with club money, I need the item name and how many times she bought it. Can you give me that list?
evidence: By "item" I mean an individual thing named in a record of what money was spent for.
gold_sql: WITH RECURSIVE split(rest, item) AS (SELECT expense_description || ',', '' FROM expense WHERE link_to_member = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison') UNION ALL SELECT substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1), trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)) FROM split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT item, COUNT(*) AS times FROM split WHERE item <> '' GROUP BY item ORDER BY item

expected.sql: WITH RECURSIVE split(rest, item) AS (SELECT expense_description || ',', '' FROM expense WHERE link_to_member = (SELECT member_id FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison') UNION ALL SELECT substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1), trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1)) FROM split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT item, COUNT(*) AS times FROM split WHERE item <> '' GROUP BY item ORDER BY item
